general_information.Description: Objective: 'This course provides English major students with an ingight to some popular ESL teaching methods in the 21st century which aim to develop a mindset of more student-centered approaches. Teaching method: lecture + project work Assessment scheme: On-going assessment: - Assignment 1: 30% - Assignment 2: 30% - Assignment 3: 30% - Oral defense: 10%
general_information.StudentTasks: <- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, and assignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information>

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify and explain the alignment of LOs, delivery and assessment in Outcome-based education (OBE)
Recognize the nature of project-based learning and its role
Sketch a project for ESL learners that can match the LOs
Design the rubrics for the project
Identify the role of assessment in OBE
Compare different kinds of assessment and their purposes
Construct an assessment scheme for an ESL course with different components

assessments.Question Type: Designing CLOs for an ESL course
Constructing a project for the ESL course thats meets some of the CLOs in assignment 1
assessments.No Question: 1. Constructing the project process (20%)2. Constructing the project rubrics (10%)

assessments.Question Type: Designing an assessment scheme that meets the CLOs in assignment 1
assessments.No Question: 1. Designing assessment components (15%)2. Explaining how the components meet the outcomes in assignment 1 (15%)

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6, LO7, LO8
assessments.Question Type: Answering teacher's questions about how the project and assessment components in their assignment 2 and 3 meet the CLOs in assignment 1
assessments.Grading Guide: individual oral assignment in front of the class
